title: Terraria: Last Prism
notes: The Last Prism's beam features a thick, brilliant white core with a vibrant, pulsating rainbow aura. Shimmering prismatic particles trail along the length of the beam, which originates from a crystalline prism and terminates in a high-intensity energy flash.

title: Destiny 2: Divinity
notes: The beam has a bright white/blue core with dancing purple electrical effects; it terminates in a spherical cage of energy on the target.

title: Overwatch: Zarya's particle beam
notes: At high energy, the beam is thick and energetic, featuring a bright white core surrounded by a pulsing magenta sheath. Thin, electrical strands of violet energy crackle and spiral along the length of the beam, while the impact point generates a brilliant flare and radiating particle sparks.

title: Real: white light through a prism
notes: A white light ray passes through a glass prism, dispersing into a vibrant, continuous spectrum of colors on a white surface. The close-up provides excellent detail on the transition between spectral colors.

title: Returnal: Phrike's lasers
notes: The beam is a vibrant orange-red with a brilliant white core, featuring a flickering, energy-pulsing texture along its length and creating showers of sparks upon impact.

title: Destiny 2: Prometheus Lens
notes: The beam has a blindingly white core surrounded by a vibrant orange-red solar aura, with a subtle pulsing motion along its length and a prominent splashing heat effect upon impact.

title: Path of Exile: Scorching Ray
notes: The Scorching Ray beam features a brilliant white-yellow core encased in a fiery golden aura. Heat distortion effects and wisps of flame move rapidly along its length towards a high-intensity impact point that emits bright sparks and a dense orange glow.

title: Real: sunlight through a lens, burning wood
notes: The sunlight is concentrated into a sharp, bright white cone by the magnifying lens. The beam is highly focused at its tip, causing the dry material to smoke and eventually ignite.

title: Destiny 2: Sleeper Simulant
notes: A high-intensity red laser beam with a brilliant white core and a lingering red energy trail. It produces a large flash on impact and ricochets sharply off hard surfaces.

title: Tutorial: vertical beam from the sky (Unreal Niagara)
notes: The beam features a brilliant white central core with outer layers of vertically scrolling energy textures. It includes Fresnel edge highlighting, a glowing impact area at the base, and upward-flying sparks and debris.

title: Real: laser beams in fog
notes: A set of four vibrant laser beams (red, yellow, blue, and green) are projected through thick fog, creating a sharp volumetric effect. The beams originate from single points and sweep through the air, forming cones and lines.
